minimal_user_steps: In an existing non-Mac Git environment that already has access to ysh0566/ponder-go, transfer only the verified M24 bundle; no credential/key transfer or permission expansion.
Verify bundle SHA256 and run git bundle verify <bundle>; git fetch <bundle> refs/heads/main; require FETCH_HEAD=4d654d598375ce75c4e448051443672326bba8c8.
Read remote main and require9180e4f915f3e3fdce27bcaf5a4e4a7c7be8da1a, otherwise review the changed remote state before writing.

Use ordinary git push <target> 3e208c1b35beaa87f936a958391ca431df80c757:refs/heads/main, verify M23 SHA/tree/author/committer, then ordinary git push <target> 4d654d598375ce75c4e448051443672326bba8c8:refs/heads/main and verify M24 SHA/tree/identities. No force, rebase, cherry-pick or replacement commit.
